zh.notice: 沿湖步道与下到水边的台阶高差明显，想轻松拍到教堂全景可走上方公共观景路。

en.notice: The lakeside approach has steeper steps. Use the upper public viewpoint for an easier exterior photo.

zh.notice: 上城门到堡垒仍需上坡。城墙有高差，开放范围以现场标示为准。

en.notice: The climb continues beyond Upper Gate. Follow signed limits on the raised ramparts.

zh.notice: 演出布置可能改变入口和座席通行。只走开放石阶，雨后留意湿滑。

en.notice: Event setup can change entrances and seating access. Keep to open steps and watch for slick stone after rain.

zh.notice: 若想看内壁画，抵达先查看入内与摄影规则；庭院可另看建筑立面。

en.notice: Check entry and photo rules before planning to see the frescoes. The courtyard offers a separate exterior view.

zh.notice: 教堂、发掘区与相邻遗址各有参观边界，按标示在公共区域观察。

en.notice: The church and excavation areas have separate visitor boundaries. Observe from the signed public paths.

zh.notice: 教堂和圣像画廊是两个参观点，分开确认入口、开放和购票。

en.notice: The church and Icon Gallery are separate visits. Confirm entrances, hours and tickets for each.

zh.notice: 从圣母教堂院区找画廊自己的入口，并按展室标识确认摄影规定。

en.notice: Look for the gallery’s own door in the church precinct and check the exhibition-room photography rules.

zh.notice: 历史宅邸有楼层和室内楼梯，行动不便者可先问馆方可进入的展室。

en.notice: The historic house has several storeys and interior stairs. Ask the museum which rooms you can reach.

zh.notice: 门洞仍用于通行。拍照时退到路侧，不在门洞正中停留。

en.notice: The gateway is still a passage. Step to the side for photographs and keep the opening clear.

zh.notice: 两座博尔尼奇教堂距离很近，用入口名称或地图地标确认目标。

en.notice: The two Bolnička churches are close together. Check the entrance label or the individual map listing.

zh.notice: 双钟孔适合从街面仰看，若院门关闭，可沿公共街道继续游览。

en.notice: The twin bell opening is visible from the street. If the gate is closed, continue on the public lanes.

zh.notice: 院门前巷道狭窄，建议步行，勿将车辆导航到教堂门口。

en.notice: The approach is a narrow lane. Walk the last stretch and avoid routing a car to the church door.

zh.notice: 礼拜期间给信众留出通行空间，入内和拍摄先现场询问。

en.notice: Leave room for worshippers during prayers and ask before entering or taking photographs.

zh.notice: 可从广场观察建筑群；内部参观先征询现场人员。

en.notice: The square gives a view of the complex. Ask on site about visiting any interiors.

zh.notice: 从广场外缘观赏树干和树冠，留意周围行人及临街出入口。

en.notice: View the trunk and canopy from the edge of the square, keeping neighbouring entrances clear.

zh.notice: 船票应核对登船码头、返程和是否含停靠门票；港口散步与乘船分开安排。

en.notice: Confirm the pier, return and any included site admission with your operator. Allow separate time for a quay walk.

zh.notice: 风浪、维修或路面湿滑时改走老城上方街巷，狭窄处让行。

en.notice: If waves, maintenance or wet decking affect access, use the upper lanes. Give way on narrow stretches.

zh.notice: 岸边空间不大，查阅当日水域与浴场告示，再决定是否下水。

en.notice: Space on the shore is limited. Check the current bathing notices before entering the water.

zh.notice: 回程走岬角路径，尽量天黑前离开湖岸。

en.notice: Allow time to return around the headland before dark.

zh.notice: 村内有居民出入口，沿开放湖边路参观，通往博物馆另找入口。

en.notice: Use public shoreline paths past homes. The museum has a separate access point.

zh.notice: 从公路下到湖岸后需原路爬坡，时间估算应包含回程。

en.notice: The walk down from the main road requires a climb back up. Include it in your timing.

zh.notice: 停车、浴场和躺椅等设施可能另收费，入口公告最适合核实。

en.notice: Parking, beach facilities and loungers may charge separately. Check notices at the entrance.

zh.notice: 村巷有坡度，拍照取景避开私人院落及车辆转弯处。

en.notice: Village lanes are steep. Choose viewpoints away from private yards and turning vehicles.

zh.notice: 这是单独的山地徒步。向公园核实道路和步道开放，带离线地图并为折返预留时间。

en.notice: Treat this as a separate mountain hike. Check road and trail access with the park, carry an offline map and allow time to turn back.

zh.notice: 预先核实可用船只、允许登岛处和返航安排；天气可能影响出航。

en.notice: Confirm an authorised boat, landing location and return arrangements in advance. Weather can affect sailings.

zh.notice: 洞窟教堂需要走台阶，先核实开放；想少走台阶可先看临湖院区。

en.notice: Check access before taking the steps to the cave chapel. The lakeside precinct is a shorter alternative.

zh.notice: 从村内确认可走的上坡入口，雨后留意岩面和踏步。

en.notice: Confirm the open uphill approach in the village. Watch for wet rock and steps after rain.

zh.notice: 用桥上的人行区域观察，沿岸留在护栏内。

en.notice: Use pedestrian space on the bridge and stay behind railings along the banks.

zh.notice: 泉区木桥和湿石会滑，沿步道走并避开水渠边缘。

en.notice: Bridges and wet stone can be slippery. Keep to the paths and away from channel edges.

zh.notice: 先走园内桥和水渠，再确认划船等单独运营项目的开放安排。

en.notice: Explore the park bridges and channels first. Check separately operated services such as boating on arrival.

zh.notice: 通过公共村巷在水渠与村中心间步行，村民院落仍作日常使用。

en.notice: Walk the public lanes between the channels and village centre. Respect residential courtyards.

zh.notice: 马赛克可能采取覆盖保护，先核实当日能看到哪些区域。

en.notice: Mosaics may be protected by coverings. Check what is visible before making a dedicated climb.

zh.notice: 以湖滨步行为主。去城堡山需另留上坡和返回时间。

en.notice: Treat this as a shore walk. Allow separate ascent and descent time for the castle hill.

zh.notice: 先问清开放的上坡入口，沿允许通行处行走，避开遗址墙体边缘。

en.notice: Confirm the open uphill approach and keep to permitted paths away from exposed ruin edges.

zh.notice: 有意乘船时先问清等候时间和价格，岸上步行可独立安排。

en.notice: Check waiting time and fare before boarding. The shore walk can be visited on its own.

zh.notice: 木栈桥临水，雨后路面湿滑；闭馆时不可自行进入水上展区。

en.notice: The timber walkway is exposed and may be slippery after rain. Do not enter the exhibit area when closed.

zh.notice: 高处路线和跨山公路受天气影响，出发前向游客中心确认通行。

en.notice: Weather affects high routes and the cross-mountain road. Check access with the visitor centre before leaving.
